title: Grudge canon entry
description: One shape for every lore, era and catalog entry that Legion and games read. Ids follow api/v1/uuid-law.json; LORE-* and ERA-* are added by canon-manifest.v1.json. No art fields: art is resolved by catalog key on assets.grudge-studio.com, and a miss shows the missing marker.

uuid.description: Deterministic id. LORE-/ERA-/SKIL-/ICON- are the first 12 hex of sha1 of the family seed. ITEM-/FOOD-/POTN-/CONS-/MATL-/RECP- are frozen catalog ids and are never re-minted.

grudgeUuid.description: Mirror of uuid for families that use the grudgeUuid field name.

slug.description: Stable seed for the id. Renaming an entry changes name, never slug.

summary.description: Short canon text Legion may quote.

status.description: Legion treats only canon as fact. draft can be shown with a caveat. held and unratified are never asserted. retired stays for old saves.

era.description: Product era. In-world history uses an age field, not era.

portrait.description: Catalog key on assets.grudge-studio.com, or null. Never a full URL to another host.

spawn.description: Spawn file path at the manifest's spawnPin commit, when Spawn is the authority.
